title: Understanding the Model
text: The model shown is a linear regression model with $$30$$ parameters (including the intercept).

title: Degrees of Freedom
text: In a linear regression model, the degrees of freedom are calculated as the number of observations minus the number of parameters.

title: Unique Solution Condition
text: For a unique OLS solution, the number of observations must be greater than the number of parameters.

title: Checking the Condition
text: Given $$n=30$$ observations and $$30$$ parameters, does the model have a unique solution?
